note: Open requests after v06. needs_new_art = the existing part art cannot express it; art_spec says what to paint. Frames refer to the v06 clips (QA atlas clips enter/exit/pass).

v05_resolution.how: One continuous trouser texture per leg (thigh rows over shin rows, cross-faded inside the texture): the knee band is gone (alpha on the leg axis at the knee >= 252 in every v06 frame; delivered v05 175-208, all legs). Strips are spaced along the 3D leg and each takes the width of its own depth (perspective taper).

Pelvic tilt follows the swinging leg (projected hip line about +-2.7 to +-3.3 deg), the shoulder line counter-tilts (0.45 of it) and the torso image turns with it; the stance-knee retime adds a vertical bob.

Rig retime in render_v06.js: while a foot is flat the body rises until that knee bends at most 18 deg (elder rig 24 deg, design), never past either leg's reach, smoothed into a bob (max 3.4-5.0 cm); feet exactly where the rig puts them. Flat-foot frames over 25 deg: 0 for all nine (v05: up to 44.4 / 42.9 deg).
